transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I’m here because some nights, usually after work or if dinner’s been tense, I start eating and it’s like I can’t really stop. Like part of me knows I’m reaching for more, but I can’t seem to make myself not do it.
Do you feel like you're in control of your eating during those episodes?

Yeah… I mean, not really. It feels like once I start, especially after work or a tense dinner, the part of me that makes decisions kind of shuts off. I can see myself reaching for more food, but I can’t seem to stop.
Do you usually feel guilty after one of these eating episodes?
I… I don’t know. Sometimes I just try not to think about it afterward. It’s uncomfortable, I guess.
Have you experienced any problems with sexual interest or function?
Um… I haven’t really noticed anything like that. Nothing I’d know how to describe, anyway.
Have you noticed any changes in your interest in sex?
Not really… I mean, I haven’t noticed a change. It’s not something I’ve been paying close attention to.
Do you feel like you have less interest in sex than you used to?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really noticed it being less than before.
Do you often find yourself having little to no interest in sex?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I wouldn’t say little to no interest. I just haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Have you ever felt like you're just going through the motions when it comes to sex?
I don’t think so… I mean, I haven’t really felt that way, not that I’ve noticed.
Do you feel like you enjoy the food when you're eating like that and can't stop?

Not really, no. At first maybe, but when it gets like that… it’s more like I’m just reaching for more and I can’t seem to stop myself. It feels like that part of me that decides things just kind of shuts off.
Do you feel like the food tastes good to you when you're eating and can't stop?
Maybe at the very start, yeah, but when I can’t stop… I’m not really noticing the taste. It’s more like I’m just watching myself keep reaching for more, and I can’t quite make myself stop.
Do you usually start eating like that when you're feeling stressed or upset?

Yeah… I think so. It’s usually after work, or if dinner’s been tense. I’ll start eating and then it’s like… I’m not really deciding anymore. I can see myself going back for more, but I can’t seem to stop.
Do you feel any pleasure while you're eating during those episodes when you can't stop?
I don’t know… not really pleasure, I guess. Maybe for a moment at the start, but after that I’m mostly just… doing it. Not enjoying it exactly.
Do you feel like you're eating much more rapidly than usual during those episodes?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to the speed… it feels kind of automatic more than anything.
Do you feel like you're able to control how much you eat during those episodes?
No… not really. That’s kind of what scares me. I’ll notice myself reaching for more, and it’s like I know I should stop, but I just… don’t. It feels like that part of me shuts off.
How often do these episodes of eating and not being able to stop happen?
Most weeks, I guess. For the last few months there’s usually been… one night where it gets out of hand. Then I try to make up for it after, one way or another.
Do you usually eat like this when you're alone or when others are around?
Usually alone. I don’t think I’d do it with someone there. On the bad nights, it’s like… leftovers, then bread or snacks, ice cream, whatever’s in the kitchen. It can be a lot in an hour or two.
How many times a month would you say these episodes of eating and not being able to stop happen?

Probably… four times a month? Like, most weeks it’s one night where I lose control. Then afterward I usually try to make up for it somehow… throwing up, laxatives, skipping food, or making myself walk a long time.
How often do you use methods like throwing up, laxatives, or excessive exercise to make up for the eating episodes?

Most weeks, I guess. If I have one of those nights, then afterward I’ll usually do something to try to undo it… throw up, or take laxatives, skip meals, or make myself walk for a long time. It’s been like that for the last few months.
Do you use these methods, like throwing up or laxatives, after every episode of eating that you can't stop?

Not every time, no. But… there have been times after everyone’s gone to bed where I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or take laxatives. I tell myself it’s just to undo the damage. I don’t feel good about it afterward… embarrassed, and kind of shaky.
Do these episodes of eating and then trying to undo it happen at least once a week for the past three months?

Yeah… I think so. Most weeks for the last few months, I’ll have one of those nights where I can’t really stop, and then I try to make up for it somehow… throwing up, laxatives, not eating, or walking a long time.
